title: Surviving the Nucleus Pulposus Desert: Next-Generation Strategies for Intervertebral Disc Cell Therapy.
snippet: Low back pain remains the leading cause of disability worldwide, with intervertebral disc degeneration representing a major biological contributor. Although cell-based therapies have shown promise in preclinical models, clinical translation has yielded modest and inconsistent outcomes.
